verdict.rationale: Cactus is an inference engine, so multi-GPU parallelism is a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents no tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism. The run-locally docs specify "no GPU", and community reports say GPUs are not used for inference at all (only for training).

support.subject: As a developer, I can distribute inference across multiple GPUs using tensor, pipeline, or data parallelism
